bridgeRouteRisk.summary: apxUSD moves cross-chain via Chainlink CCIP using the Cross-Chain Token (CCT) standard. Row-level on-chain verification on 2026-07-20 confirmed the per-chain surfaces: Ethereum is the native home deployment (ApxUSD.sol, minted natively via the reviewed MinterV0/AccessManager path; no getCCIPPool or LayerZero endpoint() surface on the token), with the CCIP Lock/Release pool 0x0e9cA42Bc60bE25F9A67f52173067Cc0Bb405BB5 locking Ethereum supply. Base (token getCCIPPool() = BurnMintTokenPool 0x49b577E70Fd22B482aaA94c3799F41f3443C24B2) and BNB Chain (getCCIPPool() = BurnMintTokenPool 0xFD957D7E27D239da5455b82303b2F618f73a9C49) are CCIP burn/mint representations; both pools return their chain's token from getToken(), are owned by the Apyx 3/6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2, and carry identical 13813-byte bytecode. No LayerZero endpoint() surface was found on any deployment.

routes.protocol: Apyx apxUSD (native home deployment; Chainlink CCIP lock/release lockbox)
routes.reviewNote: On-chain reads 2026-07-20 (Ethereum block 25570877): the apxUSD token has no getCCIPPool() and no LayerZero endpoint() surface (both calls revert), matching the home-chain ApxUSD.sol whose primary issuance runs through the reviewed MinterV0/AccessManager mint path (mint-authority review 2026-07-13, verified). The Chainlink CCIP directory lists Ethereum pool 0x0e9cA42Bc60bE25F9A67f52173067Cc0Bb405BB5 as a Lock/Release lockbox, which escrows but never mints this deployment. Native issuance.

On-chain reads 2026-07-20 (Base block 48862198): the bridged apxUSD token's getCCIPPool() returns Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 0x49b577E70Fd22B482aaA94c3799F41f3443C24B2; the pool's getToken() returns this token and owner() returns the Apyx 3/6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2 (pool bytecode 13813 bytes). The token has no LayerZero endpoint() surface. Mint/burn is gated to the CCIP pool per the verified BridgedApyxToken source, so CCIP mints this representation against the Ethereum Lock/Release lockbox.

On-chain reads 2026-07-20 (BSC block 111009463): the bridged apxUSD token's getCCIPPool() returns Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 0xFD957D7E27D239da5455b82303b2F618f73a9C49; the pool's getToken() returns this token and owner() returns the Apyx 3/6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2 (pool bytecode 13813 bytes, identical to the Base pool). The token has no LayerZero endpoint() surface. Mint/burn is gated to the CCIP pool per the verified BridgedApyxToken source, so CCIP mints this representation against the Ethereum Lock/Release lockbox.
